output.final_rationale: The verdict does not change. No genuinely new admissible evidence was provided; the Actor mainly narrowed and clarified the claim. That clarification is useful, but it does not cure the core problem identified in the initial report: the record still indicates a below-target advertising policy review segment, that segment is tied to named rollout commitments, and legal review remains open. On the available record, aggregate readiness may support launch-readiness arguments, but it does not make present certification clearly policy-compliant.
